questions.question: What does God announce concerning the nations in Joel 3?
options: He will gather and judge them in the Valley of Jehoshaphat
He will leave them all wholly untouched and at perfect ease
He will make a lasting and enduring peace with all of them
He will scatter Israel abroad among them all forever and ever
questions.answer: He will gather and judge them in the Valley of Jehoshaphat

questions.question: How is the imagery of peace reversed in Joel 3 as the nations prepare for war?
options: Flee away from the coming battle and go and hide in the high hills
Lay down all of your weapons and turn back to till your own fields
Beat your swords into plowshares and your spears into pruning hooks
Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears
questions.answer: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears
